ui: Added dimensional light, lavender edging and softened furniture detailing to the second- and third-floor clickable maps using saved room geometry, without changing original zone paths. Add white house notification badge asset, foreground chime test, and Samsung notification-channel sound help. Connected sections and useful tools to avatar areas and room doors, removed the oversized launcher from the dock; the full legacy launcher remains available internally as fallback. Installed-app icon switched to fresh, uniquely named pastel rainbow garden assets rather than the old moon; Android manifest, browser favicon, Apple home icon, offline cache and notification icons use the same colorful design. Spirituality class progress is preserved on the phone across app reloads, unfinished lessons can resume, and cloud pull/assistant sync merges spirituality lesson completion instead of losing it. Parenting and psychology lessons now open with guided practice, spoken read-aloud, and undo. Notification settings include Samsung notification category sound guidance.  The first-floor stair artwork now reads as descending to the basement and ascending to the second floor, with no arrow overlays. The second and third floor drawings now use matching pastel room illustrations, and saved upstairs photos are available in their room galleries. App and notification icons now use refreshed rainbow asset URLs to replace the stale moon icon.Car and work have separate avatar areas; task fill grows gradually. House room tiles show linked completion fill and open room details. SSD delivery is shown 10:30 AM–2:30 PM Monday–Saturday through Dec 26; backpack checks are scheduled after the latest child pickup in the first free slot, and stale morning reminders are repaired. Cleared project actions stay cleared, sync conflicts pause automatic overwrites for review, the Money account-exit checklist now uses working tap controls, Spirituality shortcuts keep consistent full-page navigation, and Money distinguishes linked accounts from budget-mapped accounts and separates balance dates from connection sync dates, and blocks confirmed-closed checking from available-cash mapping, and preserves subscription payment and renewal details across sync, and shows an estimated Added a Christmas 2026 gift planner to People → Birthdays + Gifts with recipient-by-recipient buy-or-make ideas, budget, and progress. Scheduled Christmas gift planning, purchase/making sessions and wrapping, plus Tree’s December 28 birthday tasks, categorized under Relationships in the avatar. Fix UPS schedule-photo parsing for 24-hour times and times beside printed dates. Add Christmas gift actual-spending totals, shopping links, and stable person-ID storage while preserving older gift notes. Add optional Quick Capture phone/browser dictation with a review-before-save step; explicitly stated water amounts are logged as water, with safeguards against identical active quick-capture tasks and shopping entries. Add dependency-free GitHub Actions regression tests for schedule parsing, gift saving, Quick Capture and app-release integration. No house-map or avatar geometry changed. Quick Capture now previews whether each line will save as Water, Shopping, or a Task before confirmation, and restores original in-memory records when a local save fails. Gift updates also restore their previous state on failed saves and prevent ambiguous legacy gift notes from attaching to multiple people who share a name. Expanded GitHub regression coverage and checked script syntax. Weekly UPS schedule saves now preserve actual punch and SSD mileage fields, honor intentionally cleared scheduled start times, and fully restore prior records if saving fails. Workday Focus has a one-tap SSD route logger: paste/enter SSD route start and end times plus starting/ending odometer, preview elapsed hours and derived mileage, and save only SSD delivery details while leaving preload punch times unchanged. Paid SSD hours remain unconfirmed until explicitly entered, and validation rejects backwards times or odometers. Automated tests cover schedule rollback, route calculations and save rollback, plus new script loading/offline integrity. SSD route import now distinguishes a labeled SSD time range from preload in a multi-shift message, blocks ambiguous pairs and conflicting manual-versus-odometer mileage, and reloads the selected date's fields when changing dates to avoid misattributed mileage. A user-triggered Copy SSD details action formats a text report for their supervisor without sending or saving automatically. Daily Check-in now links directly to Quick Capture and SSD route logging where available. Additional tests cover time ambiguity, date safety, clipboard summaries, and navigation. No house-map or avatar changes.
